content:
**Insect Repellent** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

A repellent composed of the body parts of several mutated local insects, stored in a glass jar.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Bloatfly Gland (1) Radroach Meat (1) Steel (2) Stingwing Barb (1) Tick Blood Sac (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Insect Repellent | | Insect Repellent (1) |
